profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc is a public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, traded under the ticker EFX. According to its website, it operates as a credit bureau, providing credit reports and credit scores to businesses and consumers. The site also describes identity protection tools with daily monitoring and alerts, including a product called Equifax Complete, and says dedicated ID Restoration Specialists work on behalf of customers who become victims of identity theft. The site offers educational material on credit reports, credit scores, debt, credit cards, loans, and fraud, along with Spanish-language resources covering Equifax credit reports in the United States, credit scores, and money management tips.

The harvested site text does not describe any AI products or AI-specific offerings. No products are tracked for the company in the available records, and no MCP servers are listed.

The records show no lawsuits involving the company. Its law exposure is recorded in Georgia, with a count of 105. The company's SEC Central Index Key is 0000033185.
